kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: GPT-5.6 Sol, along with Terra and Luna, will launch publicly this Thursday. Expanding preview access globally now.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official OpenAI confirmation of a firm Thursday public launch for the full GPT-5.6 family Sol/Terra/Luna plus global preview expansion. 2.7M views. 07-07 only had a reported Codex binding.

kept_items.author: alexandr_wang
kept_items.text: releasing muse image today - the first image generation model from MSL. it's agentic: pairs with muse spark to reason, search the web and plan before it generates. live now in the Meta AI app.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete product release: Meta Superintelligence Labs ships its first image model, Muse Image, an agentic generator live in the Meta AI app. Announced by a named exec.

kept_items.author: claudeai
kept_items.text: We're extending access to Claude Fable 5 on all paid plans through July 12.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official Anthropic update with a concrete new date: Fable 5 access extended on all paid plans through July 12. 14M views. Sharpens the 07-03 subscription-timeline story.

kept_items.author: ClaudeDevs
kept_items.text: 6 months of Claude Max 20x, on us. Expanding Claude for Open Source to more maintainers, core contributors and people keeping critical packages alive.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete company move: Anthropic expands Claude for Open Source, offering six months of Max 20x free to maintainers and core contributors. Strong engagement.

kept_items.author: ns123abc
kept_items.text: SpaceXAI and Cursor dropping Grok 4.5 tomorrow, per a staff memo; built to compete directly with Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete near-term release signal: xAI and Cursor reportedly shipping Grok 4.5 targeting Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5. Distinct model-launch news.

kept_items.author: theo
kept_items.text: GPT-5.6 is a damn good model, not quite as smart as Fable but incredibly capable; fixes GPT-5.5's problems, runs for a day without a /goal, and understands subagents.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong first-hand practitioner review of GPT-5.6 with concrete behavioural claims (long autonomous runs, subagent handling). Distinct angle from the official launch.

kept_items.author: jachiam0
kept_items.text: Josh Achiam tells OpenAI staff on Slack he is graduating this month, with no specific reason for leaving or for the timing.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete personnel move: a senior OpenAI figure announces departure in a first-person Slack message. Named source, notable engagement.

kept_items.author: Zephyr_hg
kept_items.text: Demis Hassabis tells undergraduates to become unbelievably proficient with AI tools, in a 31-minute Davos panel.
kept_items.selection_reason: Fresh Hassabis advice clip posted this morning. Concrete, quotable career guidance from a named lab CEO. Low engagement but strong source and recency.

kept_items.author: karlmehta
kept_items.text: Dario Amodei argues frontier AI needs a threat report before another launch race, saying the view into the future is cloudy on both benefits and risks.
kept_items.selection_reason: Quotable Amodei position on safety-before-speed from a longer interview. Named lab CEO, concrete framing distinct from the Hassabis and product items.

kept_items.author: NielsRogge
kept_items.text: An ICML Outstanding Paper studies Grokking, the training phenomenon where a model abruptly shifts from overfitting to generalizing after many optimization steps.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete research signal: an ICML Outstanding Paper on Grokking surfaced by a credible ML practitioner. Adds genuine research analysis.

kept_items.author: rohanpaul_ai
kept_items.text: Google's Gemini API Managed Agents move closer to production with background tasks, remote MCP, function calls, credential refresh and free-tier access.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete developer-platform update: Gemini API Managed Agents gain production features. Distinct vendor (Google) from the OpenAI/Anthropic items.

kept_items.author: RodmanAi
kept_items.text: Tencent open-sourced TencentDB Agent Memory, an AI memory system that runs 100% locally with no external vector database or cloud APIs.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source release: Tencent open-sources a local-first agent memory system. Distinct from 07-07 Hy3 model release; broadens open-source coverage.
